title: Represent an unknown-flux physical shear by a contractive two-amplitude system
statement: Induction tested on constants conserves unknown H when hB haszero mean. With b=B-H,the actual equations include +(H.grad)b in momentum and +(H.grad)u in induction,totalL2 work cancelling. Distinct Elsasser background drifts cannot both be removed by different Galilean shifts while keeping one H-independent force. From u0=0,B0=H,zero disturbances,ordinary forcing gF preserves EXACT full-MHD ansatz u=xF,B=H+(z/kappa)s_prime(x_j)e_i. Self/advection terms vanish; (B.grad)B=-kappa H_j z F is solenoidal and (B.grad)u=H_j x s_prime e_i. Thus U=(x,z) satisfies U_prime=A U+g e1, A=[[-nu kappa^2,-kappa H_j],[kappa H_j,-rho kappa^2]]. Fluctuation-pair L2 norm=|U|/sqrt2. A+Atranspose=-2diag(nu kappa^2,rho kappa^2),so ||exp(tA)||2->2<=1 for t>=0,uniformly H and positive diffusivities. For nu,rho<=1,|H|<=M,rational Lambda=100+14M dominates ||A||. This is an ACTUAL mechanically forced local coupled sector,not prescribed extra velocity or magnetic control. Matrix is proof-only. Natural invariant-respecting endpoint(V,H)doesnot imply arbitrary magnetic programming or full unknown-H controller.
